annotation: Official original Han rows +four global seed7 augmentations; unique exact compact Latin-beam match to one contiguous canonical-name fragment; identical digit groups; exclude ambiguous/no exact match. No synthetic Korean labels. Deduplicate query/fragment pairs, equal query weight across alternate spellings.
inner_validation: GroupShuffleSplit20% of outer-training Han vessels, seed20261029; purge exact query/fragment pairs shared with inner validation from fit. Select minimum validation tokenNLL among epochs1/3/6/12; refit all outer-training pairs from public checkpoint for selected epoch count. No outer-score checkpoint choice.

training.optimizer: Adafactor constant baseLR0.001, relative_stepFalse, scale_parameterFalse, warmup_initFalse, weight_decay0.01
training.lr_schedule: linear warmup10% then linear decay over12epoch horizon, including refits stopping earlier

scoring.direction: P(Latin fragment including EOS | observed Korean name)
scoring.name_marginal: full canonical name0.5, remaining distinct contiguous fragments uniform0.5; single-word prior1
scoring.runtime: Each query only; no cross-row pair cache. Offline cache only after exact companion/slot checks and weight hashes.

matched_control: Identical length normalisation and fixed residual0.3 applied to the same public untuned ByT5 checkpoint; no alternate coefficient
anchor: Actual v12 distribution restricted and normalised over its original base top20; on its original pruned rows use actual base fallback, not invented neural logits
byte_pruning: Anchor top2 gap greater than3/7+1e-6 provably preserves winner; never apply old1/3 bound to the new expert
caveat: Repeated exploratory synthetic CV and historical v8 outer retrieval mapper exception. Forward frozen beams have original fewshots; report no-shot sensitivity. Weak fragment supervision can be wrong despite exact spelling. Label-aware oracle used for pretraining architecture analysis, not performance forecast.
conditional_execution: Only if raw sequence primary fails its initial two-fold screen; no fallback after a qualifying primary fails fresh/full
score: Each fragment logP divided by its own UTF8byte+EOS length, multiplied by median target length in that outer-training full data, then same0.5/0.5fragment marginal; compatibility score, not proper sequence probability
registration_reason: Unequal Latin target lengths and small-data inner tokenNLL motivated a single training-derived length correction; no outer performance or predictions inspected; primary unchanged
